summary: Iteration 39 verified end-to-end: backend salary-cap enforcement on /api/roster/{id}/add (over-cap denial with 'salary cap' detail), live /compliance.salary_used recompute for Zarek's Frozen team ($86M used / $88M cap), drop-then-recompute lowers salary_used; web /team page hides View-full-roster link + league switcher, sidebar shows 'Active league - Ice Kings Head-to-Head' above League Hub, TeamSalaryCap card renders REAL data ($86.0M used / $88.0M cap, $2.0M remaining) instead of old hardcoded $92.5M; web /matchup page side-rail cards are clickable, banner 'Viewing Top Shelf Titans @ Ice Breakers · Back to my matchup' appears, main player list refreshes to viewed teams, Back-to-my-matchup resets state. 18/18 targeted backend tests pass (1 pre-existing skip on roster round-trip).

issues: When viewing another matchup via the side-rail card, the top scoreboard still shows the user's own team logos/names (ZF Zarek's Frozen vs TST Top Shelf Titans) while the player lists and banner correctly show the viewed matchup (Top Shelf Titans @ Ice Breakers). The team-name labels above the player lists also remain 'ZF Zarek's Frozen' even though the players shown are Ice Breakers'. Banner + player swap work, but the scoreboard header (team logos, ZF/TST chips, VS score, projections) does not fully re-render for the viewed matchup. Cosmetic — core feature works.
Pre-existing: a global 'No available roster move can resolve violations' alert toast appears top-right on /team (carried over from iteration 38, not new).

action_items: (Optional polish) /matchup: when viewingMatchup is set, also re-render the top scoreboard (team logos, names, scores, projections, week label, win-prob bar) to match the viewed matchup — currently only the banner + player lists update. Banner correctly says 'Viewing Top Shelf Titans @ Ice Breakers' while header still shows 'Zarek's Frozen vs Top Shelf Titans' and stale 137.5 vs 101.0 numbers.
critical_code_review_comments: TeamSalaryCap.tsx fetches /compliance and renders accurately ($86.0M/$88.0M for Zarek). Cap-disabled and over-cap empty/warning states should be exercised in a future iteration with a non-cap-enabled league + a deliberately over-cap team to fully cover branches.

MatchupSideRail.tsx + Matchup.tsx implement viewingMatchup correctly via onSelectMatchup prop, but the top scoreboard inside Matchup.tsx still derives from myMatchup instead of (viewingMatchup || myMatchup). Consider extracting an 'activeMatchup' selector and using it everywhere on the page for consistency.

test_salary_cap_enforcement.py has a third test that re-adds the dropped player in a finally block — this works for happy path but if the re-add fails (e.g., over-cap because synthesized salary changed), the team state will be left short by one player. Acceptable for now but flag for future hardening.
